headline: Chinese Listed Firms' Dividend Growth Lags Global Average
summary: Chinese listed companies reported core third-quarter dividend growth of 5.3%, lagging behind the global average of 7.5% and casting doubt on Beijing's market stabilization initiatives.
why: Corporate payout growth is a key metric for institutional investors evaluating shareholder returns and capital allocation discipline in major economies.

impacts.name: Chinese Equities
impacts.why: Lagging dividend growth reflects slower corporate cash distributions relative to global peers.
